dataset.target: order not delivered as promised (cancelled, never delivered, or late)

split.method: chronological; last 20% held out and never used for fitting or tuning

operating_point.detail: flag when risk x freight x prevention > friction, which is a different cutoff for every order

policies.detail: flag when risk x freight x prevention > friction, which is a different cutoff for every order
flag when risk >= 0.1382, chosen on the validation window
flag the riskiest 27.3% of orders, that share chosen on the validation window

threshold_selection.chosen_on: the last 25% of the training window (19,733 orders), scored by a model fitted only on what came before it

action_bands.basis: confirm = per-order expected value (a different cutoff for every order; the median is 0.1921); prepay = 99th percentile of held-out predicted risk (worst 1% of orders)
